title: ResearchMD Phase 3 job message
description: The only shape the Pages API puts on the research-jobs pull queue and the only shape the worker accepts. Pointers, not content: no user tokens, no Firebase claims, no PHI, no PDF bytes. The worker reads everything else from R2. Messages that fail this schema are never worked; they retry to the DLQ and alert.

v.description: Message schema version. Workers refuse any other value.

jobId.description: research_jobs.id. One job id per (projectId, idempotencyKey); the API enforces the unique pair.

kind.description: Phase 3.2 implements pdf_extract only. New kinds are a contract change, not a silent extension.

projectId.description: research_projects.id. Scopes every R2 key the job may touch.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied key, echoed in the callback. Same key plus project means same job; a replayed delivery skips work (see callback.md).

r2Key.description: Private R2 object key of the uploaded PDF (retention.md layout). The projectId inside the key must equal the message projectId; the worker checks this before reading.

maxPages.description: Hard page ceiling for this job. The worker also enforces the global 60 even if a message asks for more.

maxSeconds.description: Wall-clock ceiling for extraction. The worker also enforces the global 240.

createdAt.description: Unix seconds when the API enqueued the message. Audit only; never used for auth.
